summary: Cleanup of 49 stale branches (25 local + 24 remote) that were merged into main but never deleted. CC#53 (extends CC#46) added to vault-drift-sweep.md to detect future drift across all milestone prefixes (chore/*, feat/mX-*, fix/mX-*, ms-*). check_vault_drift.sh now reports a dynamic count of python-executable vs bash-documented CCs. CC#53 is bash-only (validated via CI branch-merged check, not CC#48 meta-check). 5 local + 19 remote not-merged branches preserved for human triage (documented in branches-deleted.log).
title: 65 stale branches cleanup

subject.gap: CC#46 only watched fix/m9-*. Across M0-M8 milestones, every merge to main accumulated stale branches in chore/*, feat/mX-*, ms-* prefixes (25 local + 24 remote merged). Plus 5+19 not-merged branches represent abandoned work requiring human triage.
subject.fix: CC#53 added (bash) extends CC#46 to all milestone prefixes. 49 merged-stale branches deleted (safe: git branch -d refuses unmerged). Recovery: branches-deleted.log records the tip SHA of every deleted branch (git branch <name> <sha> recreates). Reflog is the backstop for 90 days. Not-merged branches preserved and documented.
